system_summary.NAME: EVOLVED_MULTI_AGENT_SYSTEMS_COMPOSED_SYSTEM
system_summary.PURPOSE: Enable interacting decision makers to coordinate or coexist under explicit information, incentive, authority and failure conditions, with evidence for the intended collective consequence.
system_summary.SYSTEM_FORM: A conditional composition of compatible mechanisms, alternative configurations and feedback relations. It is neither the union of every property nor a mandatory serial pipeline or central governor.
system_summary.OBJECTS_AND_STATE: Participants and rights; local observations/histories; task/resource state; intentions and public commitments kept distinct; norm/role relations; strategy or policy models; outcome evidence and unresolved effects.
system_summary.OPERATION: Actors exchange binding information, propose/accept obligations, allocate or constrain resources, act through their actual capabilities and respond to observed changes. Plans, actions and observations may run concurrently. Goal change, failure, disputed meaning and partner change can interrupt an interaction and select repair, renegotiation or termination.
system_summary.SMALLEST_COHERENT_FORM: A declared interdependence and population, a minimally adequate interaction, capable and authorised actors, a consequence criterion and observation path, and a response to relevant assumption/failure changes. Richer models are conditional selections.
system_summary.CLAIM_LIMIT: No source or experiment validates this entire composed system. The four composition-induced properties EMAS-071–074 articulate new dependency obligations rather than a newly proven guarantee.

relation_direction: FROM REQUIRES TO means the former relies on the latter in the guard. Alternatives/conflicts do not require simultaneous implementation. PROVIDES_EVIDENCE_FOR can be explicitly partial and does not transfer a stronger guarantee.

nodes.NAME: Population, rights and environmental boundary
nodes.DESCRIPTION: Defines agents and external principals, locally available information, utilities, capabilities and actual decision rights.

nodes.NAME: Tasks, resources and material effects
nodes.DESCRIPTION: Task identities, current allocations, resources, time constraints and uncertain executed effects; not just conversation text.

nodes.NAME: Communication and local interaction histories
nodes.DESCRIPTION: Alternative semantic accounts plus correlation and local protocol state; claims of current standard equivalence remain version-specific.

nodes.NAME: Joint and social undertakings
nodes.DESCRIPTION: Joint-goal persistence and conditional social commitments are distinct objects; they can be linked only through an explicit justified mapping.

nodes.NAME: Strategic allocation and collective choice
nodes.DESCRIPTION: Alternative game, mechanism, voting and argumentation models; none defines all collective values.

nodes.NAME: Organisation and normative relations
nodes.DESCRIPTION: Roles, missions, norms, observation/enforcement powers and bounded revision; computational institutions do not issue external legitimacy.

nodes.NAME: Distributed constraint branch
nodes.DESCRIPTION: Finite constraint model with explicit privacy, cost and fault-specific alternatives rather than an obligatory global solver.

nodes.NAME: Adaptation and partner-conditioned policies
nodes.DESCRIPTION: Learning state, information availability and partner expectations can change together; revisions need collective tests.

nodes.NAME: Collective observations, failure and repair
nodes.DESCRIPTION: Grounded progress, outcomes, source dependence and threat-specific response; consensus is not an observation oracle.

nodes.NAME: People, external principals and evaluation
nodes.DESCRIPTION: Human participation, comparable costs, evidence roles, programme dependence and external transfer boundaries.

nodes.NAME: Cross-layer closure and change guards
nodes.DESCRIPTION: Analytical coupling of the above elements, configuration selection and continuity across change; not a new universal controller.

nodes.NAME: Rejected shortcuts
nodes.DESCRIPTION: Negative candidates constrain interpretation; they are not operative modules or new required owners.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Selecting an agent boundary
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The comparison concerns the same work and rights.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A central comparator is given powers or information unavailable to the distributed actors.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Define what is distributed and which dependency agent decomposition actually addresses.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Boundary modelling and comparator construction can exceed the value of a trivial design.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: A later setting must establish whether the simpler comparator is feasible.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A robustness claim relies solely on decentralisation
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Faults and trusted dependencies can be specified.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Different process names are assumed to imply independent utility knowledge or failure.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Replace the rejected universal claim with the chosen fault-specific construction.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Replication and diagnosis add communication and trusted components.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No resilience to faults outside the declared construction follows.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: An extra participant is proposed as automatic improvement
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Collective success and total cost can be compared.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Count of agents is treated as a causal guarantee.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Retain an added participant only for an evidenced marginal contribution.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Removing apparent redundancy can lose valuable specialisation.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: A task-specific comparison is required; the negative candidate is not a ban on teams.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Multiple interactions or consequential messages
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Roles can recognise relevant bindings and state changes.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Valid syntax is presumed to establish the full semantic effect.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Bind messages to an interaction and distinguish the transitions each message can evidence.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Semantic/version maintenance and longer messages.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Environment events still need trustworthy interpretation.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Choosing public semantics for opaque participants versus mental-state semantics for inspectable agents
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Either branch declares its semantic object.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Private sincerity is publicly testable without an observation or verification route.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Use commitment/information effects at an open boundary; retain mental-state reasoning within a justified closed implementation.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Bridging internal intention and public obligation remains an extra mapping.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Neither branch alone proves actual compliance or sincerity.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Roles or performatives are used as evidence of cooperation
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: There is a consequence that matters beyond the label.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Naming an act creates agreement, authority or fulfilment by itself.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Treat the label as syntax until an operative semantic relation and observation support it.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: May require replacing a convenient but misleading interface.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Conventional labels remain useful when their interpretation is established.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A design claims FIPA compatibility today
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Exact version and implementation can be identified.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: The inspected experimental 2001 library is interchangeable with inaccessible final versions or current runtimes.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Leave current equivalence unresolved until the exact profile and conformance evidence are available.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Version investigation and compatibility testing.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Current final-profile text, implementation and conformance evidence remain unavailable in this corpus.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: The selected protocol admits a model-level completion analysis
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The exact meaning of liveness is preserved.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Existence of a permitted completion entails actual willingness, delivery or work.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Model analysis excludes a class of protocol dead ends, but an execution/progress observer is still needed.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: State exploration and potentially misleading use of the word live.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: BSPL completion possibility is not an eventual-execution guarantee.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: An allocator assigns work involving shared resources
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Capability reports and feasibility predicates are adequate.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Award is identical to accepted and completed work.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: The allocation becomes a proposal or commitment through the task lifecycle and resource controls.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Negotiation, stale capacities and double allocation.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Assignments need effects and observations at the actors controlling resources.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Economic task exchange is selected
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Cost, participation and transfer rules describe the actual interaction.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Cooperative cost estimates are honest in an open strategic setting by default.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Choose the compatible bargaining or incentive model before asserting welfare properties.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Payments, strategic search, enforcement and opportunity costs.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: A local improvement condition need not provide global optimum or incentive compatibility.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Dependencies can be removed or bundled without violating requirements
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The altered task/resource boundary remains acceptable.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Decentralisation or negotiation must be preserved regardless of cost.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Eliminate the conflict rather than repeatedly negotiating it.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Partitioning can strand resources or remove useful flexibility.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: The cheaper structure must not hide necessary cross-boundary interdependence.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Interleaved local planning needs selected global dependencies
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Plan summaries are timely enough for a consumer.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: All agents possess an instant complete plan.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Exchange partial plans to adjust timing and detect team assumptions requiring repair.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Stale views can cause redundant work or mutual waiting.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Communication organisation and update frequency remain setting-specific.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Negotiation is required even though a suitable authorised owner is known
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: There is no unresolved allocative or consent choice.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Process observance itself supplies value.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Use direct assignment or no coordination unless negotiation earns its cost.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Omitting bidding may miss a hidden lower-cost executor.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: The non-trigger must be established rather than asserted.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A party seeks justified withdrawal or cannot perform
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The contract defines withdrawal and other parties can receive the change.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Cancellation deletes dependent obligations or already executed effects automatically.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Reconcile compensation, delegation and remaining work before recontracting.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Strategic decommitment and repeated replanning can harm predictability.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Enforceability of penalties and external effects must be established.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A joint undertaking persists despite incomplete knowledge
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Participants have compatible team objectives and notification conditions.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Every recipe is complete or every belief is common knowledge.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Partial plans specify contribution; monitoring detects reconsideration; selective messages repair expectations.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Persistent commitments can become costly or obstruct escape from obsolete goals.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No single source proves the entire hybrid under all information models.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Both mechanisms address incompletely specified distributed activity
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Planning information is incomplete and revisable.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Similar wording establishes direct derivation from PGP to SharedPlans.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Preserve their shared distributed-planning problem while keeping their state representations distinct.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Unwarranted semantic merging would erase intention versus scheduling differences.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Direct influence between these particular works is not asserted.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Obligations are assessed from public interaction
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Debtor, creditor, conditions and event meanings are identifiable.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A received utterance alone validates its antecedent or consequent in the world.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Use observable lifecycle events to assess the relevant conditional commitment.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Ambiguous or disputed events yield diverging accounts.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: External truth and enforcement remain outside a bare commitment semantics.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Delegation or assignment crosses principals or versions
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Identity and the selected delivery/order conditions are satisfied.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: The 2009 reliable/FIFO alignment model automatically tolerates loss and arbitrary reorder.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Preserve responsibility and compatible commitment state across the transfer.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Extra messages and temporary disagreement until quiescence.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: More permissive transports require a different argument or tested reconciliation.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A team assumption, member or capability changes
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: A monitor can observe a material deviation and an actor can respond.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Detecting deviation is equivalent to restoring the team.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Notify and revise plans, reallocate or terminate the affected undertaking.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: False alarms and repair cascades consume capacity.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Continuous action monitoring absent from SharedPlans must be supplied, not attributed to that formalism.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Communication is selected by information value and recipient cost
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Relevant events and consumers can be distinguished.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Unrestricted messages always improve coordination.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Send information that changes an action or expectation; test omission where it does not.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Incorrect value estimates suppress essential warnings.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: The alem ablation and kitchen/XAI limits concern different task structures, not a universal message optimum.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Universal common belief is demanded before cooperation
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Useful coordination may need less than ideal common knowledge.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Every practical joint act requires unbounded confirmation.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Retain sufficient explicit notification or partial shared plans under the chosen model.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Weaker knowledge may admit residual coordination failures.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Knowledge impossibility does not establish impossibility of all useful cooperation.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: The population can deviate strategically
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The utility, information and solution concept are explicit.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Equilibrium is identical to goodness or institutional permission.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Evaluate both strategic stability and the independently selected collective criterion.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Richer opponent models increase computational and data burdens.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Unmodelled preferences and strategies can invalidate the evaluation.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Truthfulness, participation, budget and full efficiency are demanded together in bilateral trade
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Independent overlapping private-value assumptions of the theorem hold.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: All desiderata are simultaneously achievable in that domain.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Relax a specified requirement or domain assumption instead of promising an impossible mechanism.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Relaxation imposes a real loss on someone.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: The theorem does not select the socially appropriate relaxation.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Stable behaviour or trust is used to justify open interaction
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Deviation opportunities and exposure can be tested.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Observed cooperation is stable against collusion or trust rebuilding.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Use adversarial histories and changed opponents to test purported stability.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Testing can miss a strategy outside the finite search set.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Simulation and restricted meta-strategies do not enumerate real-world deviations.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Contracts are restricted to a limited exchange neighbourhood
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Task-bundle and resource interactions are represented.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Bilateral exchanges explore every useful coalition or resource externality.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Match the contract language/search scope to interactions necessary for improvement.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Larger contract spaces can be computationally unaffordable.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: The selected neighbourhood may still end in a local optimum.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: An organisation relates roles, goals and normative responsibilities
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Role compatibility, missions and norm applicability are explicit.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A chart alone makes agents adopt or execute responsibilities.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Connect structural permission and functional goals to applicable obligations and feasible plans.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Consistency checks and translation between models.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Plan augmentation is an optional newer branch, not a requirement of all organisational models.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A norm is claimed to control behaviour
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Relevant actions are observable or a dispute procedure can establish them.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Every external act is observable and every simulated sanction is externally legitimate.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Choose prevention, detection/sanction or voluntary reasoning within actual institutional powers.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Surveillance, sanctions and prevention can each impose different participation costs.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: External legitimacy cannot be established by the norm program alone.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A norm must influence an agent
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: A choice exists between constraining available action and enabling deliberation.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Representing a violation means either all violations are prevented or the violation is authorised.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Use regimentation when prevention is possible/appropriate; use norm-aware choice where autonomy remains.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Prevention may block useful discretion; deliberation may choose harmful violation.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: The branches can coexist for different acts but are not equivalent guarantees.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Goals, roles or capabilities change
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: An authorised revision process preserves or renegotiates existing relations.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: The system may invent its own authority by revising its model.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Monitor, propose, select and implement a bounded organisational change, then evaluate dependent interactions.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Reorganisation costs, disruption and oscillation.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: The 2004 simulated reorganisation framework does not certify arbitrary self-governance.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Role charts are offered as proof of organisation
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Roles can be connected to assignments, goals and enforcement.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Names instantiate adoption, capability or obligation automatically.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Require a usable mapping from role to decisions and interaction; otherwise omit the chart.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Formal role descriptions can burden a very small team.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: A lightweight role description can still be sufficient when it has a real consumer.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Distributed search is used under unreliable communication
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Finite domains, message assumptions and search rules are stated.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: The original reliable finite-delay FIFO assumptions cover arbitrary transport faults.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Separate the optimisation guarantee from the execution substrate obligations.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Additional recovery may alter convergence or complexity.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: A new substrate requires its own consistency with the algorithm model.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Joint resource/assignment decisions can be modelled as a finite DCOP
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The cost decomposition and structural width are suitable.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Exact optimisation is always preferable to a central scheduler or approximation.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Choose ADOPT, DPOP or a cheaper alternative according to memory, time, messages and quality demands.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: DPOP message size grows exponentially with induced width; search can be expensive.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Modelled objective quality may differ from real collective value.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Costs or beliefs must be kept private
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: A particular adversary and leakage definition are accepted.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Distributed location alone protects information or all evidence can remain hidden while publicly checked.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Minimise/protect disclosures consistent with the optimisation and public accountability needs.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Cryptographic/protocol overhead and residual inference.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No arbitrary-malicious or collusion guarantee is asserted beyond the inspected protocol.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: An argumentation outcome is used as knowledge
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The argument/attack graph and chosen semantics are justified.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: An accepted argument is true merely because of graph membership.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Separate dialectical acceptability from provenance, observation and factual warrant.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Different semantics may return different or no stable extensions.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Evidence that constructs the graph remains a separate burden.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A voting rule selects a collective alternative
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The preference domain and mechanism class are known.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Strategyproofness, fairness and factual correctness are interchangeable.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: State which social-choice limitations and domain restrictions apply to the decision rule.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Restrictions or randomisation change the property being offered.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: The Gibbard result is not a theorem that every collective decision is impossible.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Many agreeing reports are treated as independent corroboration
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Their evidence ancestry and sampling units can be inspected.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Repeated messages from one mistaken source are independent observations.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Track shared inputs/models/judges and assess the evidential claim at the actual independent unit.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Provenance collection and dependence estimation are costly.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: The correct dependence model and independent ground truth may remain unknown.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Policies are learned among changing agents
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Training and deployment population changes are identified.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A stationary single-agent evaluation represents co-adapting partners.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Test decentralised execution, partner shifts and repeated training variability separately.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Population testing expands the evaluation space.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: A finite population test cannot prove general open-population coordination.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Centralised training is followed by local execution
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Execution policies only consume permitted local inputs.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: The critic’s training information is also available to deployed actors without cost.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Keep the training/execution information contract and representation restrictions explicit.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Reduced information can reduce attainable performance.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Runtime communication, if added, changes the original comparison.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Local rewards or factored values guide updates
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Reward attribution and the chosen joint criterion are specified.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Local value improvement implies collective welfare.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Evaluate credit assignment and the representable joint value before accepting local optimisation as global progress.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Additional joint tests and potentially slower learning.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Monotonic factorisation is a restricted model class, not a universal coordination solution.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: An agent encounters unseen machine or human partners
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Partner distributions and shared conventions are described.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Self-play success proves ad-hoc team competence.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Evaluate cross-play or representative human interaction before transferring a policy to the new team.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Testing and adaptation burden; artificial partner samples may mislead.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Known symmetry randomisation does not cover arbitrary human norms.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A learned convention is presented as an institution
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The normative criterion is independent of behavioural persistence.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Stable, majority-supported or profitable behaviour is necessarily legitimate.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Distinguish recurrence, explicit rule formation, enforcement and external justification.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: A norm can suppress beneficial deviation or stabilise collusion.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Model votes and resource survival do not supply human political or legal legitimacy.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Interacting policy updates improve individual metrics
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Joint effects and update schedules are observable.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Local gains alone establish monotone collective improvement.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Measure collective trajectories and retain a revision only under declared joint criteria.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Slower updates and residual non-stationarity.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No general convergence guarantee is supplied by this synthesis.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A simulation or benchmark is used to justify deployment
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The relevant environmental assumptions have a target analogue.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Demonstration, use and causal benefit are the same evidence.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Treat transfer as a distinct hypothesis with deployment-specific observations and comparators.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Transfer validation can cost more than initial modelling.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Field effectiveness of the composed system has not been measured.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A known failure threatens a collective obligation
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The affected state and trusted recovery authority are identified.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Any one recovery method covers crash, deception, common-mode corruption and version conflict.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Choose recovery, fallback or replication according to the specific failure and protected property.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Redundancy, false suspicion and duplicate-action risk.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Some failures require safe suspension rather than automatic retry.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Work is abandoned or completion uncertain
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Effects may be observed or their uncertainty represented.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: An unavailable worker implies no irreversible action occurred.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Reconcile existing effects and obligations before delegating or repeating resource-changing work.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Recovery can block while uncertain effects are checked.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No universal exactly-once execution theorem is imported here.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Direct verification is costly but bounded risk is acceptable
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Past evidence is relevant and identity persists.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Reputation certifies the present action or prevents a first defection.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Use trust to choose limited exposure, retaining direct checks for consequences that need them.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Manipulation, punitive lockout and identity resets.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Trust does not replace task-specific evidence when stakes exceed the accepted exposure.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Local compliance continues without useful progress
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: A progress consumer can distinguish waiting, stalling and completion.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A legal next step ensures anyone will execute it.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Raise a repair or termination decision based on collective observations.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Timeout or progress criteria can mistake slow work for failure.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Liveness depends on environment and participation assumptions as well as protocol structure.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A coordinator or common service fails
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The fallback preserves identities and outstanding effects.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A replacement can start a clean interaction while the old actors remain active.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Re-establish compatible coordination and handle in-flight obligations or suspend.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Fallback may concentrate authority or lose performance.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: The new configuration must be judged under its own failure and information model.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A participant or implementation changes
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Compatibility includes semantics, commitments, permissions and learned expectations.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A syntactically compatible message or familiar role name suffices for admission.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Selectively re-establish the dependencies actually affected by the change.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Admission checks may exclude useful agents or become a bottleneck.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: An open-world universal compatibility test is not supplied.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A mechanism claims superiority
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Costs, tools, information and units are disclosed.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Training, inference, wall time and thinking tokens are silently treated as equal.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Use a defensible comparator and state unmatched quantities; narrow claims after negative or null results.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Design-space comparisons and instrumentation require resources.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No one cost metric serves every deployment.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Established MAS vocabulary is used for an LLM collective
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Actual prompt/protocol/tool behaviour is inspectable.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: An LLM role prompt supplies the semantics or guarantee of a classical formalism.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Map implemented interactions to the classical mechanisms or label the resemblance as analogy.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Mechanism reconstruction can reveal that the advertised system is mostly central orchestration.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: The classification alone gives no performance or safety guarantee.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Comparisons are reported across runs or programmes
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Sampling and evidence ancestry can be traced.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Many traces from one framework equal many independent deployments.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Attach results to the true units, shared sources and uncertainty.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: More metadata and more expensive independent replication.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: The packet does not establish field replication for every retained criterion.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: People participate in consequential teamwork
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: People can understand, refuse or alter the relevant action within real powers.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: An approval box or constant explanation grants meaningful oversight.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Present decision-relevant information and preserve actual human control and accountability.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Workload, attention limits and incompatible expectations.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: A small game study does not establish usable oversight in high-stakes deployment.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Local activities are composed into a collective claim
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The collective criterion is explicit and observable.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: All local success predicates imply the desired joint state.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Check timing, compatibility, resource effects and the independent collective objective.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: End-to-end measurement can expose irreducible uncertainty.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: A measured outcome may still omit harms outside the chosen boundary.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A consequential interaction is accepted as complete
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Evidence, obligations, powers and material effects refer to compatible objects.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Observing a state automatically authorises action; executing an act automatically establishes its consequence.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Close only the justified links from observation through normative/decision change to authorised act and observed effect.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Cross-layer reconciliation and possible unresolved disputes.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: This is an analytical composition property, not a named historical theorem or evaluated whole system.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A model-defining assumption changes during operation
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Dependencies of guarantees on assumptions are known.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A previously valid guarantee survives every participant or environment change.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Identify affected guarantees, choose a compatible branch and dispose of outstanding work.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Suspension, handoff delay and transition failures.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: A later setting must identify which changes are detectable and who may authorise transition.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Choosing, simplifying or retiring a mechanism
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: The protected failure, consumer and cheaper alternative are identified.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: Either maximum machinery or minimum machinery is always better.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Retain the least costly adequate configuration while preserving necessary evidence and obligations.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Simplification can remove rare but valuable protections.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Adequacy and cost remain context-specific judgements.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: A policy, protocol or organisational revision is evaluated
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Dependent partners and outstanding expectations can be identified.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A local reward increase self-authorises a collective change.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Test dependent constraints and expectations, then preserve, negotiate or explicitly replace them.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Revision can stall or create oscillatory reorganisation.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: No generic safe self-modification guarantee is established.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: FT-DCOP replication is feasible for the selected optimiser
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Correct utility knowledge and replica/message assumptions match the construction.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: The global agent count alone meets the per-function knowledge threshold, or approximate results become optimal.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Preserve fault-free algorithm messages through the studied replicated computation and account for added messages.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: O(k²) message multiplication per original message and replication of bad common knowledge.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: Supplementary impossibility proof was not independently checked; applicability beyond the model remains a transfer claim.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Norm-related plans are constructed in a BDI implementation
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Norm conditions, compliance actions and valuations are supplied.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A chosen violation is legitimate or a running example establishes scalable dynamic norm compliance.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Augment goal-plan alternatives with compliance steps and consequences; evaluate the resulting choice within institutional constraints.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Plan growth, valuation errors and conflicts between new norms and current plans.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: The 2026 extended abstract leaves larger-scale overhead and dynamic norms unresolved.

relations.CONTEXT_OR_GUARD: Argument acceptability is established or contested by an inter-agent dialogue rather than entirely within a single reasoner.
relations.SHARED_ASSUMPTIONS: Chosen argument semantics, locally available reasons, meaningful support/challenge/update rules and a consumer of the result.
relations.INCOMPATIBLE_ASSUMPTIONS: A syntactically legal dialogue necessarily terminates, exposes private sincerity, or makes accepted premises true.
relations.COMPOSITION_MECHANISM: Couple the reasoning criterion to move and state-update rules, then assess useful stopping independently of move legality. Preserve disagreement or absence of sufficient reasons.
relations.NEW_FAILURE_OR_COST: Repeated legal exchanges, private-precondition opacity, omitted withdrawal and argument-search cost; the inspected two-party model does not establish unrestricted multiparty negotiation.
relations.UNRESOLVED_OBLIGATION: The deployment must justify its argument inputs, protocol-specific stopping behaviour and any transfer beyond the inspected branch.

alternative_configurations.NAME: Smallest coherent direct coordination
alternative_configurations.SELECTION_GUARD: A few participants have clear rights and a simple shared dependency.
alternative_configurations.OMITTED_OR_ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: No general auction, full SharedPlans representation, norm institution, learning or DCOP is required. A direct authorised scheduler may dominate.
alternative_configurations.OPERATION: A principal/peer expresses a concrete dependency; a capable participant acts; the relevant recipient observes the outcome. Only consequential exceptions cause messages or repair.
alternative_configurations.SUBSTITUTION_OR_RETIREMENT_CONDITION: Omit agent coordination entirely if ordinary services or one actor satisfy the boundary and requirements.

alternative_configurations.NAME: Cooperative team with revisable plans
alternative_configurations.SELECTION_GUARD: Shared objective and enough inspectability/notification to maintain a joint undertaking.
alternative_configurations.OMITTED_OR_ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Closed mental-state reasoning and partial plans do not imply open-market incentive compatibility. Public commitments can be added at opaque boundaries.
alternative_configurations.OPERATION: Local work and partial-plan exchange run concurrently; changed goals or failed members interrupt, trigger notification and revise contribution plans.
alternative_configurations.SUBSTITUTION_OR_RETIREMENT_CONDITION: Use direct coordination when plan uncertainty or role interaction no longer justifies team machinery.

alternative_configurations.NAME: Open strategic interaction
alternative_configurations.SELECTION_GUARD: Distinct principals exchange services/resources while retaining their own objectives.
alternative_configurations.OMITTED_OR_ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Do not assume joint intentions, truth-telling, shared utility or enforceable penalties merely because agents participate.
alternative_configurations.OPERATION: Public commitments track obligations; the selected mechanism governs offers/acceptance; authorised observers establish effects and disputes, not private-belief access.
alternative_configurations.SUBSTITUTION_OR_RETIREMENT_CONDITION: Replace bargaining with a simpler posted/direct protocol when it satisfies consent, incentives and allocation needs.

alternative_configurations.NAME: Structured distributed optimisation
alternative_configurations.SELECTION_GUARD: Finite decomposable objective and a justifiable need to keep decisions or information distributed.
alternative_configurations.OMITTED_OR_ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Privacy protection and fault-tolerant replication are independent optional extensions with extra assumptions. CTDE or auctions are not mandatory.
alternative_configurations.OPERATION: Select exact or approximate search according to graph structure and costs; translate assignments into actions separately; measure actual joint consequences.
alternative_configurations.SUBSTITUTION_OR_RETIREMENT_CONDITION: Use central or local deterministic optimisation if privacy, locality or ownership does not justify distributed computation.

alternative_configurations.NAME: Adaptive collective in a controlled environment
alternative_configurations.SELECTION_GUARD: Repeated experience can improve policies and the population/dynamics are sufficiently testable.
alternative_configurations.OMITTED_OR_ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: CTDE and monotonic factorisation are choices, not the definition of learning or emergence. A learned convention is not an externally legitimate institution.
alternative_configurations.OPERATION: Policies update within a declared experimental regime; partner/cost/constraint tests determine whether a local change is a permissible collective revision.
alternative_configurations.SUBSTITUTION_OR_RETIREMENT_CONDITION: Prefer a fixed protocol if learning offers no robust gain or prevents maintenance of required constraints.

alternative_configurations.NAME: Human-agent and organisational overlay
alternative_configurations.SELECTION_GUARD: Human participants or an institution retain material decisions, responsibilities or vetoes.
alternative_configurations.OMITTED_OR_ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: An approval checkbox, role chart or norm-aware planner is not meaningful oversight. This overlay can couple to other configurations.
alternative_configurations.OPERATION: People receive actionable information and exercise actual powers; norm detection and enforcement use available observability; revision preserves participant commitments.
alternative_configurations.SUBSTITUTION_OR_RETIREMENT_CONDITION: Remove redundant explanations/structures when the human consumer and risk no longer require them, without silently deleting accountability.

ceremony_stripping_ledger.PROTECTED_FAILURE: Artificially fine-grained workers add negotiation and translation costs; a biased baseline manufactures benefit.; Serial bottlenecks, correlated errors and context fragmentation can worsen outcomes.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PREREQUISITES: A defined task, explicit rights and comparable information/cost accounting.; Comparable task, information and total resource budget.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.MINIMAL_ADEQUATE_ALTERNATIVE: One actor, a scheduler or ordinary services with the necessary rights and information.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.TRIGGER_FOR_FULLER_FORM: Irreducibly separate capabilities, information, incentives or control.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.COSTS_OF_SIMPLIFICATION: May lose parallelism, autonomy or unique capabilities.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.OMISSION_OR_RETIREMENT_CONDITIONS: Remove the extra agent when its contribution disappears and obligations can be transferred.

ceremony_stripping_ledger.ARTEFACT_RITUAL_OR_BRAND: Performatives, role prompts and ontology documents
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PROTECTED_FAILURE: Correct parsing can mask different meanings of task, completion or permission.; Public records can still be false about the world or too coarse to establish fulfilment.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.CONSUMER: Actual message recipient and obligation counterparty
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PREREQUISITES: Both sides can map fields and effects to the same declared interpretation.; Agreed event interpretation, participant identities and observable messages or consequences.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.MINIMAL_ADEQUATE_ALTERNATIVE: A small agreed vocabulary and explicit effects for the interaction.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.TRIGGER_FOR_FULLER_FORM: Heterogeneous open participants or many evolving message types.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.COSTS_OF_SIMPLIFICATION: Less expressive semantics may reduce interoperability or detect fewer errors.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.OMISSION_OR_RETIREMENT_CONDITIONS: Omit unused vocabularies; preserve bindings relied upon by live conversations.

ceremony_stripping_ledger.ARTEFACT_RITUAL_OR_BRAND: Full conversation diagrams and protocol verification
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PROTECTED_FAILURE: Correct sequencing with the wrong task identifier remains an unsafe interaction.; Completion possibility is confused with actual eventual willingness, delivery or fulfilled work.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.CONSUMER: Implementers and participants who rely on legal interaction
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PREREQUISITES: Identity binding, data integrity and local history sufficient for the selected protocol.; Finite or analysable protocol state; valid information assumptions and a specified environment model.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.MINIMAL_ADEQUATE_ALTERNATIVE: A direct protocol with a few explicit information dependencies.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.TRIGGER_FOR_FULLER_FORM: Concurrency, open enactment or costly dead ends justify formal analysis.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.COSTS_OF_SIMPLIFICATION: Manual reasoning may miss reachable dead ends.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.OMISSION_OR_RETIREMENT_CONDITIONS: Retire unused protocol branches only after in-flight interactions are resolved.

ceremony_stripping_ledger.ARTEFACT_RITUAL_OR_BRAND: Contract Net bidding on every task
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PROTECTED_FAILURE: Stale bids, hidden costs and interacting tasks make a locally cheap award infeasible.; Premature completion, abandoned awards and duplicate execution on retry.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PREREQUISITES: Comparable suitability criteria, current capacity and an agreed award/acceptance protocol.; Task identity, completion criterion, responsible parties and an observation path.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.MINIMAL_ADEQUATE_ALTERNATIVE: Direct authorised assignment or a simple posted offer.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.TRIGGER_FOR_FULLER_FORM: Uncertain suitability, consent or material alternative costs.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.COSTS_OF_SIMPLIFICATION: May miss a better or willing provider.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.OMISSION_OR_RETIREMENT_CONDITIONS: Drop bidding when allocation is predetermined and comparison confirms no lost value.

ceremony_stripping_ledger.ARTEFACT_RITUAL_OR_BRAND: Complete shared plans and constant team meetings/messages
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PROTECTED_FAILURE: Stubborn persistence under harmful goals; cost-prohibitive attempts to establish ideal mutual belief.; Unrecognised resource conflict and incomplete monitoring remain outside a purely intentional specification.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.CONSUMER: Contributors whose actions depend on others
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PREREQUISITES: Joint objective, participant set, persistence conditions and a viable notification path.; Understandable action recipes, relevant capabilities and reconciliation of subplan obligations.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.TRIGGER_FOR_FULLER_FORM: Critical dependencies, uncertainty or failure consequences justify richer shared state.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.COSTS_OF_SIMPLIFICATION: Insufficient disclosure can hide conflicts or obsolete assumptions.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.OMISSION_OR_RETIREMENT_CONDITIONS: Remove meetings/updates that no longer change an action or expectation.

ceremony_stripping_ledger.ARTEFACT_RITUAL_OR_BRAND: Role charts and large organisational models
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PROTECTED_FAILURE: Well-formed diagrams conceal missing performers or unreachable organisational goals.; A title persists after capability loss; permissions are broader than actual assignment.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PREREQUISITES: Interpretable goals, role definitions and a mechanism linking role adoption to actual responsibilities.; Current capabilities, identity, compatibility rules and an authorised assignment process.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.MINIMAL_ADEQUATE_ALTERNATIVE: A few explicit roles, permissions and task relations.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.TRIGGER_FOR_FULLER_FORM: Open roles, complex mission dependencies or institutional obligations.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.COSTS_OF_SIMPLIFICATION: Too little structure can hide incompatible roles or unclear accountability.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.OMISSION_OR_RETIREMENT_CONDITIONS: Retire models with no decision consumer, preserving necessary responsibilities.

ceremony_stripping_ledger.ARTEFACT_RITUAL_OR_BRAND: Norm text, sanction labels and human approval boxes
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PROTECTED_FAILURE: Powerful tools bypass the intended decision maker; formal norms are mistaken for legal authority.; Unseen external acts and ambiguous rules render a norm operationally inert or falsely enforced.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.CONSUMER: Affected participants and legitimate decision makers
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PREREQUISITES: Named action/resource and an identifiable source of authority.; Norm meaning, observable facts, legitimate response powers and a fallible-observation policy.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.MINIMAL_ADEQUATE_ALTERNATIVE: A usable constraint or decision rule with an observable action and real authority.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.TRIGGER_FOR_FULLER_FORM: Violations must be detected/contested or meaningful discretion exercised.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.COSTS_OF_SIMPLIFICATION: Removing records may impair contestation and accountability.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.OMISSION_OR_RETIREMENT_CONDITIONS: Do not retain unenforceable or authority-free observance as proof of control.

ceremony_stripping_ledger.ARTEFACT_RITUAL_OR_BRAND: Universal auctions, voting or equilibrium claims
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PROTECTED_FAILURE: One computed equilibrium is non-unique, inaccessible or irrelevant to bounded actors.; Collusion, externalities, non-modelled values, approximate computation or unenforceable payments defeat the claim.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.CONSUMER: Participants in a real allocation/preference decision
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PREREQUISITES: Feasible actions, payoffs or preference model, information and participation assumptions.; Declared type domain, transfer powers, utility assumptions and the exact equilibrium or dominance condition.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.MINIMAL_ADEQUATE_ALTERNATIVE: Direct agreement, restricted-domain choice or a simpler authorised rule.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.TRIGGER_FOR_FULLER_FORM: Private information or divergent preferences create a genuine mechanism-design problem.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.COSTS_OF_SIMPLIFICATION: Simpler rules can reduce participation, efficiency or resistance to manipulation.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.OMISSION_OR_RETIREMENT_CONDITIONS: Omit formal mechanism machinery when no strategic choice requires it.

ceremony_stripping_ledger.PROTECTED_FAILURE: Dropped messages, false constraints or changed variables invalidate completeness claims.; Exponential messages, stale objectives or incomplete utility specification erase practical value.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PREREQUISITES: Finite domains, identified neighbours/agents and the algorithm’s reliable ordered-delivery assumptions.; Finite DCOP, correct utility/cost functions, compatible ownership and algorithm-specific transport.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.MINIMAL_ADEQUATE_ALTERNATIVE: Central computation, decomposition or bounded-quality search.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.TRIGGER_FOR_FULLER_FORM: Distributed information/rights, quality requirements or privacy/fault needs justify it.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.COSTS_OF_SIMPLIFICATION: Approximation or centralisation may sacrifice required guarantees or privacy.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.OMISSION_OR_RETIREMENT_CONDITIONS: Retire expensive distribution when its protected constraint disappears.

ceremony_stripping_ledger.ARTEFACT_RITUAL_OR_BRAND: Debate rounds, majority votes and multiple judges
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PROTECTED_FAILURE: Unknown shared training or hidden data reuse prevents reliable independence estimates.; All agents share one mistaken premise or one persuasive but false explanation.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PREREQUISITES: Provenance sufficient to distinguish shared sources from genuinely distinct observations.; The rejected claim would require a defensible error/independence model and truthful evidence, not just agreement.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.MINIMAL_ADEQUATE_ALTERNATIVE: Independent evidence checks or a single capable agent with the same resources.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.TRIGGER_FOR_FULLER_FORM: A tested complementary information/error structure produces net improvement.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.COSTS_OF_SIMPLIFICATION: Reducing diversity may remove genuine correction opportunities.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.OMISSION_OR_RETIREMENT_CONDITIONS: Stop rounds without new independent evidence or outcome gain.

ceremony_stripping_ledger.PROTECTED_FAILURE: Self-revision conceals self-authorisation; redesign cannot fix an impossible external goal.; A policy improves against an obsolete partner or destabilises mutual adaptation.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PREREQUISITES: Change authority, assessment criterion, current obligation state and an implementation path.; Declared update schedules, partner populations and evaluation horizon.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.MINIMAL_ADEQUATE_ALTERNATIVE: Stable policy/protocol plus bounded explicit revision.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.TRIGGER_FOR_FULLER_FORM: Drift or new tasks demonstrably make the fixed system inadequate.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.COSTS_OF_SIMPLIFICATION: A fixed policy may respond too slowly to changed circumstances.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.OMISSION_OR_RETIREMENT_CONDITIONS: Retire adaptation with no persistent collective gain or controllable interface.

ceremony_stripping_ledger.PROTECTED_FAILURE: Multiple role names conceal one model or one compromised information source.; Con strategies rebuild reputation before costly defection; strict penalties punish noisy honest actors.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.PREREQUISITES: A stated invariant, fault scope, trusted components and observation limits.; Identity continuity, relevant observations and an explicit model of noise and strategic manipulation.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.MINIMAL_ADEQUATE_ALTERNATIVE: A bounded direct check, narrow redundancy or explicit safe suspension.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.TRIGGER_FOR_FULLER_FORM: Repeat interaction or a specified fault warrants the added mechanism.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.COSTS_OF_SIMPLIFICATION: May lose availability or useful historical risk information.
ceremony_stripping_ledger.OMISSION_OR_RETIREMENT_CONDITIONS: Retire scores/replicas that lack predictive/protective value under the actual threat model.

internal_tensions.NAME: Autonomy versus coordination
internal_tensions.PROTECTED_VALUES: Participant freedom and predictable joint contribution.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_A: Independent principals or rapidly changing opportunities need refusal/withdrawal.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_B: Dependent work needs stable undertakings and notice.
internal_tensions.SUPPORTED_HYBRID_OR_SELECTION_RULE: Use bounded commitments with agreed release, not total control or unrestricted abandonment.
internal_tensions.HYBRID_FAILURES_AND_COSTS: Strategic withdrawal or over-rigid commitment harms others.
internal_tensions.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: How much stability must each party purchase or accept?

internal_tensions.NAME: Privacy versus shared information
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_A: Private utility or sensitive state has a real protection requirement.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_B: Feasibility, public obligation or repair needs shared evidence.
internal_tensions.SUPPORTED_HYBRID_OR_SELECTION_RULE: Share/protect exactly the information required by a defined protocol; keep privacy claims adversary-specific.
internal_tensions.HYBRID_FAILURES_AND_COSTS: Residual inference or opaque obligations remain.
internal_tensions.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Can the needed guarantee be obtained under the actual leakage budget?

internal_tensions.NAME: Individual incentives versus collective value
internal_tensions.PROTECTED_VALUES: Voluntary participation, strategic stability and collective outcomes.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_A: Open principals may refuse or manipulate.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_B: Scarce resources and affected outsiders make global consequences important.
internal_tensions.SUPPORTED_HYBRID_OR_SELECTION_RULE: Declare the mechanism trade-off; change assumptions or relax a named desideratum when necessary.
internal_tensions.HYBRID_FAILURES_AND_COSTS: A welfare-improving mechanism can exclude participants or stabilise harmful collusion.
internal_tensions.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Who is entitled to choose the trade-off?

internal_tensions.NAME: Flexibility versus protocol guarantees
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_A: Tasks and participants change beyond a rigid pre-scripted sequence.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_B: High-cost interactions need fixed information and commitment invariants.
internal_tensions.SUPPORTED_HYBRID_OR_SELECTION_RULE: Use flexible enactments constrained by information identity and explicit revision/handoff.
internal_tensions.HYBRID_FAILURES_AND_COSTS: Admission/revision can break earlier obligations or become too expensive.
internal_tensions.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: How permissive can the protocol be while retaining the required property?

internal_tensions.NAME: Local responsiveness versus global consistency
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_A: Local observations become stale quickly or communication is expensive.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_B: Conflicting actions can cause irreversible joint failure.
internal_tensions.SUPPORTED_HYBRID_OR_SELECTION_RULE: Identify the specific cross-agent invariant; reconcile only dependencies that can violate it.
internal_tensions.HYBRID_FAILURES_AND_COSTS: Global checks can delay response; local updates can oscillate or double act.
internal_tensions.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: No universal communication interval or update schedule is established.

internal_tensions.NAME: Diversity versus integration cost
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_A: Unseen partners or heterogeneous resources supply unique value.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_B: Shared formats or specialised extra agents cause overhead.
internal_tensions.SUPPORTED_HYBRID_OR_SELECTION_RULE: Compare task-specific heterogeneous teams with their credible homogeneous/simple alternatives.
internal_tensions.HYBRID_FAILURES_AND_COSTS: Shared model ancestry may preserve common errors despite role diversity.
internal_tensions.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: When does diversity change the error structure rather than only the labels?

internal_tensions.NAME: Enforcement versus discretion
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_A: Preventable high-consequence acts justify restricting capability.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_B: Uncertain norms and exceptions require interpretation and accountable judgement.
internal_tensions.SUPPORTED_HYBRID_OR_SELECTION_RULE: Regiment only suitable acts; model remaining obligations and dispute/decision rights explicitly.
internal_tensions.HYBRID_FAILURES_AND_COSTS: Excess control blocks useful acts; deliberation permits harmful choices.
internal_tensions.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: External legitimacy and contested facts remain independent burdens.

internal_tensions.NAME: Exact quality versus time, messages and privacy
internal_tensions.PROTECTED_VALUES: Optimal modelled objective and feasible operation.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_A: Small structured problems require certified optimum or privacy.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_B: Dynamic or large problems make exact distributed search unaffordable.
internal_tensions.SUPPORTED_HYBRID_OR_SELECTION_RULE: Select bounded-quality/central/local alternatives and state the sacrificed guarantee.
internal_tensions.HYBRID_FAILURES_AND_COSTS: The optimum can arrive after its assumptions expire.
internal_tensions.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: What quality loss is acceptable for the actual consequence?

internal_tensions.NAME: Transparency versus human attention
internal_tensions.PROTECTED_VALUES: Actionable knowledge and limited cognitive bandwidth.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_A: People need timely information about a blocking or changed action.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_B: Experienced users already infer status and narration interferes.
internal_tensions.SUPPORTED_HYBRID_OR_SELECTION_RULE: Trigger useful explanations and test actual outcomes/attention rather than mere display.
internal_tensions.HYBRID_FAILURES_AND_COSTS: No explanation may hide a conflict; excessive explanation may obscure the task.
internal_tensions.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: The small 2026 null study does not settle modality or expertise effects.

internal_tensions.NAME: Adaptation versus continuity
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_A: Changed goals or populations make the old policy inadequate.
internal_tensions.CONTEXT_FAVOURING_B: Existing obligations and jointly feasible actions must persist.
internal_tensions.SUPPORTED_HYBRID_OR_SELECTION_RULE: Evaluate dependent interfaces and make a bounded transition or renegotiation.
internal_tensions.HYBRID_FAILURES_AND_COSTS: Locally useful revisions can induce collective instability or permanent review.
internal_tensions.RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Stable general self-revision remains unproved for the combined system.

composition_tests.NAME: Many agents share one mistaken source
composition_tests.INPUT_OR_CHANGED_ASSUMPTION: Ten roles all repeat the same false database entry.
composition_tests.COMPOSED_RESPONSE: Preserve one evidence origin; agreement does not multiply support. Seek independent observation or leave the answer unverified.
composition_tests.DISCRIMINATING_OBSERVATION: Whether any additional report has an independent evidential path.
composition_tests.RESIDUAL_OBLIGATION: Independent ground truth may be unavailable.

composition_tests.NAME: Syntactically accepted message, different meanings
composition_tests.INPUT_OR_CHANGED_ASSUMPTION: One version uses complete to mean dispatched, another to mean delivered.
composition_tests.COMPOSED_RESPONSE: Prevent the completion claim from crossing the mismatched semantic boundary; reconcile meaning and live conversations.
composition_tests.DISCRIMINATING_OBSERVATION: The recipient’s state and the actual delivery event.
composition_tests.ADJUDICATION: Parsing is not semantic acceptance or performance.
composition_tests.RESIDUAL_OBLIGATION: A migration rule must preserve earlier commitments.

composition_tests.NAME: Task awarded but no completed work
composition_tests.INPUT_OR_CHANGED_ASSUMPTION: An award is accepted but the worker disappears after possibly changing a resource.
composition_tests.COMPOSED_RESPONSE: Treat responsibility and effects separately, observe uncertain work, then retry/reassign/terminate only within recovery rights.
composition_tests.DISCRIMINATING_OBSERVATION: Material task state, not the award message.
composition_tests.ADJUDICATION: Allocation does not discharge the obligation.
composition_tests.RESIDUAL_OBLIGATION: Irreversible unobserved effects may block a safe retry.

composition_tests.NAME: Cooperative protocol meets a strategic entrant
composition_tests.INPUT_OR_CHANGED_ASSUMPTION: A participant begins inflating cost reports for private gain.
composition_tests.COMPOSED_RESPONSE: Suspend the honest-cost welfare claim; choose compatible incentives/public commitments or decline the interaction.
composition_tests.DISCRIMINATING_OBSERVATION: Outcome under deviating reports and actual enforcement.
composition_tests.ADJUDICATION: A cooperative benchmark no longer warrants the claim.
composition_tests.RESIDUAL_OBLIGATION: No selected mechanism may satisfy all desired goals.

composition_tests.NAME: Individually improving policies oscillate collectively
composition_tests.INPUT_OR_CHANGED_ASSUMPTION: Agents simultaneously adapt to yesterday’s congestion and chase the same alternate resource.
composition_tests.COMPOSED_RESPONSE: Measure the joint trajectory and resource constraints; assess a coupled policy/update change rather than accepting local reward improvements.
composition_tests.DISCRIMINATING_OBSERVATION: Stability, throughput and resource use over complete cycles.
composition_tests.RESIDUAL_OBLIGATION: No universal damping parameter is supplied.

composition_tests.NAME: Single scheduler beats negotiation-heavy MAS
composition_tests.INPUT_OR_CHANGED_ASSUMPTION: One authorised scheduler has the same information, feasible control and lower total cost.
composition_tests.COMPOSED_RESPONSE: Use the scheduler; preserve task/effect observations and any genuine principal boundaries.
composition_tests.DISCRIMINATING_OBSERVATION: Matched quality, time, resources and rights.
composition_tests.ADJUDICATION: A non-agent or central path is a valid selected outcome.
composition_tests.RESIDUAL_OBLIGATION: A hidden privacy or authority constraint could invalidate the comparator.

composition_tests.NAME: Favourable complementary team handover
composition_tests.INPUT_OR_CHANGED_ASSUMPTION: Different agents control necessary complementary resources and share a feasible objective.
composition_tests.COMPOSED_RESPONSE: Coordinate acceptance, timing and handover; notify only changes affecting dependent action.
composition_tests.DISCRIMINATING_OBSERVATION: The joined resource/action consequence occurs within its window.
composition_tests.ADJUDICATION: A justified cooperative configuration survives the cheap-path test.
composition_tests.RESIDUAL_OBLIGATION: New costs or failures may still remove its advantage.

composition_tests.NAME: No coordination trigger
composition_tests.INPUT_OR_CHANGED_ASSUMPTION: Independent deterministic services have no shared resource or strategic dependency.
composition_tests.COMPOSED_RESPONSE: Do not add negotiation, norms or team beliefs; retain only required service interfaces.
composition_tests.DISCRIMINATING_OBSERVATION: No consequential cross-service dependency is lost.
composition_tests.ADJUDICATION: MAS machinery is inapplicable, not missing.
composition_tests.RESIDUAL_OBLIGATION: Revisit if the actual workload introduces shared constraints.

composition_tests.NAME: Delivery assumptions change
composition_tests.INPUT_OR_CHANGED_ASSUMPTION: A reliable FIFO channel is replaced by one that drops/reorders messages.
composition_tests.COMPOSED_RESPONSE: Withdraw alignment/search claims dependent on that transport; add a justified compatible layer or change mechanism.
composition_tests.DISCRIMINATING_OBSERVATION: Message histories against the original model obligations.
composition_tests.ADJUDICATION: A theorem is not refuted merely because its assumptions were removed.
composition_tests.RESIDUAL_OBLIGATION: The replacement needs its own evidence.

composition_tests.NAME: Goal becomes obsolete and continued effort harmful
composition_tests.INPUT_OR_CHANGED_ASSUMPTION: A joint target is no longer wanted or feasible.
composition_tests.COMPOSED_RESPONSE: Notify, reconsider and settle dependent obligations rather than maximising persistence.
composition_tests.DISCRIMINATING_OBSERVATION: Acknowledged changed goal and disposition of outstanding actions.
composition_tests.ADJUDICATION: Persistence is conditional, not blind loyalty.
composition_tests.RESIDUAL_OBLIGATION: Who may declare irrelevance may be disputed.

composition_tests.NAME: Norm violation occurs outside the institution’s observations
composition_tests.INPUT_OR_CHANGED_ASSUMPTION: A prohibited physical action is not visible to the norm engine.
composition_tests.COMPOSED_RESPONSE: Record the enforcement gap; use an authorised external observation/dispute route or narrow the claim.
composition_tests.DISCRIMINATING_OBSERVATION: An independently established action and an effective permitted response.
composition_tests.ADJUDICATION: Declared norms and norm-aware plans do not establish enforcement.
composition_tests.RESIDUAL_OBLIGATION: Privacy and legitimate jurisdiction may preclude full observation.

composition_tests.NAME: Replicas share wrong utility knowledge
composition_tests.INPUT_OR_CHANGED_ASSUMPTION: Replicas all consistently use an incorrect common cost function.
composition_tests.COMPOSED_RESPONSE: Do not infer correctness from replica agreement; distinguish message consistency from objective validity.
composition_tests.DISCRIMINATING_OBSERVATION: Utility provenance and correspondence to the actual objective.
composition_tests.ADJUDICATION: Fault-free behaviour can preserve a wrong model.
composition_tests.RESIDUAL_OBLIGATION: No replication scheme here supplies truth of the utility input.

composition_tests.NAME: Airport security scheduling
composition_tests.INPUT_OR_CHANGED_ASSUMPTION: ARMOR documents operational scheduling at LAX beginning in 2007.
composition_tests.COMPOSED_RESPONSE: Use as evidence that a strategic decision aid operated with human constraints, not proof of universal decentralisation or prevented attacks.
composition_tests.DISCRIMINATING_OBSERVATION: Documented use and modelled schedule behaviour.
composition_tests.ADJUDICATION: Deployment is supported; causal security benefit is not established by the short demo report.

composition_tests.NAME: Staged human-agent disaster exercise
composition_tests.INPUT_OR_CHANGED_ASSUMPTION: Four outdoor trials examined human-agent task allocation in a simulated disaster.
composition_tests.COMPOSED_RESPONSE: Treat participant decisions, connectivity and completion observations as part of the system, not as external afterthoughts.
composition_tests.DISCRIMINATING_OBSERVATION: Task outcomes and participant/practitioner feedback in the reported setting.
composition_tests.ADJUDICATION: Field-trial evidence informs components; it is not a real-disaster deployment claim.
composition_tests.RESIDUAL_OBLIGATION: Representativeness and operational transfer remain open.

composition_tests.NAME: Communication ablation versus explanation null result
composition_tests.INPUT_OR_CHANGED_ASSUMPTION: alem agents need explicit messages for coordination; a small human game study found no significant explanation benefit.
composition_tests.COMPOSED_RESPONSE: Select communication by dependency and consumer rather than applying one global message rule.
composition_tests.DISCRIMINATING_OBSERVATION: Collective outcome with and without the particular channel/content.
